routes.name: Algeria entry visa (tourist, business, family, transit)
routes.summary: Most foreigners need a visa from an Algerian embassy or consulate. Validity can be 90 days, 180 days, 1 year or 2 years, with up to 90 days per stay and 180 days per year.

other: Some nationals are exempt from the visa, but the page doesn't list them. Ask the embassy.
Tourists need a hotel booking plus agency confirmation or a legalized host invitation.
Business visas need an invitation letter from an Algerian company.
Passport valid at least 6 months. Travel insurance required.

stay.note: Max 90 days per entry, extension not beyond 90 days. Cumulative stay no more than 180 days per year. Transit visa stay is 7 days.

documents: Two passport photos on white background
Hotel booking or invitation, depending on visa type

fees.label: Tourism, business, family, transit, student, medical, press (US applicants)

routes.processing: About 5 to 8 business days on average, varies by nationality.

sources.label: Embassy of Algeria in Washington: entry visa to Algeria

routes.name: Algeria work and temporary work visa
routes.summary: For foreigners with a job in Algeria. Needs paperwork from the Algerian Ministry of Labor. Temporary work can use a service contract.

other: Work: work contract, foreign worker list, temporary work authorization and repatriation commitment from the Ministry of Labor.
Temporary work: service contract, or employment contract with provisional work authorization and repatriation commitment.

sources.label: Embassy of Algeria in Washington: entry visa to Algeria

routes.name: Algeria student visa
routes.summary: For enrolled students. Needs an enrollment letter from an accredited institution and proof of financial support.

other: Enrollment letter from an accredited institution.
